title: Internal and external cultivation: unleashing the potential of photogenerated carrier dynamics behaviors to boost photocatalytic CO2 hydrogenation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5539-5551
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00605H, Paper
Yuhao Guo, Qinhui Guan, Xingjuan Li, Mengjun Zhao, Na Li, Zizhong Zhang, Guiqiang Fei, Tingjiang Yan
The catalyst derived from Prussian blue precursor, using the “internal and external cultivation” strategy, fully exploits the potential of each step of photogenerated carriers in photocatalytic CO2 hydrogenation, effectively promoting CO production.
